title: Sources: Moonshot AI closes its final private funding round at a ~$50B valuation and is targeting a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027 to raise up to $5B (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Moonshot AI closes its final private funding round at a ~$50B valuation and is targeting a Hong Kong IPO in Q1 2027 to raise up to $5B — Moonshot AI has closed the final round of private fundraising at a valuation of about $50 billion and is heading toward an initial public offering …
